title.narrative: ICRC operations by the Abidjan (regional) Delegation(2023 Unaudited)

description.narrative: The ICRC's Abidjan delegation helps displaced persons in Côte d'Ivoire and Malian refugees in Burkina Faso. In all the countries covered, we visit places of detention and help the authorities promote compliance with international humanitarian law. In Guinea, the ICRC protects and assists people affected by the violence that occurs in the country from time to time. In Liberia, the ICRC promotes detainee welfare, provides water and sanitation, supports the Liberian National Red Cross Society, and promotes international humanitarian law. In addition, we support Ivorians who have fled violence in their own country and the Liberians who are hosting them.
